# Audit Website Skill

Audits a website with the squirrelscan CLI across 260+ rules in 21 categories (SEO, performance, security, technical, content, accessibility and more), returns a compact LLM-optimized report, maps every finding to the template, component or content file behind it, then drives an iterative fix loop — fix in batches, re-audit, compare before/after scores and catch regressions against a baseline — until all errors are resolved and the score target is met. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: you must install the squirrel CLI and have a live site URL to audit (the skill prefers the live site, since only there do you see true rendering, performance and redirect behavior); findings are fixed in your code and content, so this works best if you can edit the site yourself or hand the fixes to a developer; crawls should respect your host's rate limits. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
